Privacy: local review build

This is an honest notice about this local review copy, not the privacy notice a published website would need. The items marked pending must be decided and drafted with qualified advice before any release.

What this copy does

  • It runs only on your computer. It makes no requests to any other site, uses no cookies, analytics or tracking, and stores nothing in your browser.
  • The form on Contact us is an inactive example. It does not send, store or keep what you type, and nothing is placed in the page address.
  • Email links open your own email program only if you choose to use them. Nothing is sent automatically.

Still to be decided before release

    The legal entity, its registered details and a contact for privacy questions.
